changelog:
Fastmail JMAP Skill v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Adds pure Python Fastmail email integration via JMAP API (no dependencies)
- Supports inbox listing, search, read, send, move, trash, mark-read/unread, and mailbox management
- Simple CLI: `python3 scripts/fastmail.py <command>`
- Requires only a Fastmail API token (no OAuth)
- Designed for agent integration and easy automation
summary: Give your AI agent email superpowers via Fastmail JMAP. Read, search, send, move, trash — zero deps. By The Agent Wire (theagentwire.ai)
